results.evidence: Automatic AI publication is disabled. Any AI-assisted/generated/programmatic asset marked published must carry explicit human approval plus matching APPROVE_AI_CONTENT_PUBLICATION:<assetId> decision-ledger evidence; negative fixture proves fail-closed behavior.

All indexable runtime SEO registry records are pairwise compared with deterministic phrase-aware unigram+bigram Jaccard similarity using thresholds.similarityMax from site config. This preserves the configured 0.70 gate while avoiding template-vocabulary false positives across distinct CN intents; above-threshold near-duplicate fixture is still rejected.
Managed published assets are evaluated against thresholds.decayDays and thresholds.contentDebtWarnPct; current managed set has no stale post-change review debt as of 2026-08-09.
Five high-regulatory-risk assets explicitly record missing expert-review evidence. No reviewer identity or endorsement is fabricated; gaps remain visible warnings for later human evidence.

Official public and synthetic sample datasets may be public; user-derived data defaults to deny pending approved privacy review; private customer evidence is prohibited from public data-asset publication.
Managed assets carry explicit date-only meaningful-change/review records; invalid, future or review-before-change dates are rejected and unmanaged paths cannot masquerade as governed assets.
